summary: This video provides a complete answer key for all 10 days of the Summer Night Riddles event in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. It reveals the correct choices for both the lore-based text questions and the hero sketch identification puzzles across all 20 riddles. Completing every riddle correctly earns players event achievements, Heliolite Dice, Auric Tokens, and limited-time cosmetic rewards. Players are advised to pay attention to the exact answer text rather than option letter placements, as answer choices may be randomized.
tips: Verify the exact text of each answer choice before selecting, as option letter positions (A, B, C, D) can be randomized per player.
Get riddles right on the first attempt to receive extra bonus rewards with each claim.
Complete all 20 text and sketch riddles to unlock the limited event achievement titles Riddlecraft Insight and Conundrum Crusher.
title: 🚨 I DID THEM ALL So You Don't Have To 🚨 All Summer Night Riddle Answers | Dragonheir x Dragonstride
